body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: d0f0a80bb3d1263c53f2397965fa4aa67357ead1 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next cut).

**What looks good**
- Whole-file refusal by name for a bad library, with no overwrite of a corrupt file; save, replace and delete edit the file as confirmed save actions.
- `InsertFixture` is one undo unit and refuses a missing setup or a bad pick or entry by name.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new code, and all new files are under 400 lines with provenance lines.
- No snapshot PNGs, dependencies, `build.rs`, `.github` or scripts touched relative to `NeoTech/main`, and no `CHANGELOG.md` edits. The body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #339`, and the decisions file is in place.

**Local results** (trial-merged with upstream main, clean, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `fixture_library` | 6 passed |
| app `fixture_ux` | 9 passed |
| app `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| app `commands_undo` | 32 passed |
| ui `tests/fixtures` | 7 passed |
| ui lib | 380 passed, 1 failed (`headless_run_succeeds`, no GPU adapter on this machine; not caused by the PR) |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The atomic-write helper duplicates #383's machine store, as the body says; fold it into one helper once both land.
- Hands-on check is the contributor's; the headless kit run in the comments looks complete.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
